purpose: Define containment/parent-child structure separately from general semantic relations so hierarchy cannot be inferred from arbitrary relation edges.

topics.name: Containment and Relation Separation
topics.purpose: Define containment/parent-child structure separately from general semantic relations so hierarchy cannot be inferred from arbitrary relation edges.

semantics.relation_rule: General relations remain separate typed edges.
semantics.ownership_rule: Containment does not automatically imply semantic ownership unless declared.
semantics.cycle_rule: Containment cycles are invalid for tree/acyclic profiles.
semantics.projection_rule: UI tree projection uses containment only unless a view explicitly chooses another relation.
semantics.authority_rule: Parent containment does not automatically grant AccessCore rights to child.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.

hard_gates.condition: relation edge becomes parent by layout
